rv.q: ...director Jonathan Kent has lavished no end of care on the production... But you are still faced with a fantastical drama that meanders back and forth around an alarmingly repetitive stock of philosophical ideas...'
'Peter Gynt' increasingly feels like a chore, and a smattering of good humour can't conceal the play's fundamental sour slogginess.
McArdle [is] the main reason to see the play.
